# Verelios Labs

> Verelios Labs is a software development company in Govind Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, founded in 2024. It builds custom websites, cross-platform mobile apps, and business software — ERP, CRM, HRMS and payroll, billing and inventory — plus AI automation, for businesses in Kanpur and across India. Every engagement starts with a free mockup delivered within 48 hours and runs on milestone payments of 30% / 30% / 40%, so there is no large upfront cost. Clients own the source code outright. Rated 5.0 from 53 Google reviews.

Last updated: 2026-08-23

## Key facts

- **Name:** Verelios Labs (also "Verelios")
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Website:** https://www.verelios.com
- **Office:** 126/58 G Block, Govind Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208006, India — one physical location
- **Service area:** Kanpur and Uttar Pradesh in person; the rest of India remotely
- **Phone:** +91 82995 22798
- **WhatsApp:** +91 84710 94125 (a different number from the phone line)
- **Email:** contact@verelios.com
- **Hours:** Open 24 hours, every day (IST)
- **Rating:** 5.0 stars from 53 Google reviews
- **Projects delivered:** 50+
- **Founder:** Sahil Chauhan, who runs the initial scoping call on every project
- **Free mockup:** a visual mockup or prototype within 48 hours, before any payment or commitment
- **Payment:** milestone-based — 30% to start, 30% at mid-delivery, 40% at launch. Fixed quote up front, not billed hourly.
- **Code ownership:** the client owns the source code and it sits on their own hosting and domain accounts. No vendor lock-in.
- **Post-launch:** 7 days of free support, then optional monthly maintenance
- **Typical delivery:** most projects launch in under 3 weeks; business websites in 7–14 days; mobile apps in 3–5 weeks; ERP and custom software in 4–8 weeks
- **Tech stack:** React, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, hosted on Vercel or AWS
- **Integrations commonly built:** Tally, the GST portal, Razorpay and UPI, WhatsApp Business API

## Pricing

Starting prices. Each project is quoted at a fixed price after a scoping call.

| Service | Starts at | Typical delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Business website (up to 5 pages) | ₹49,999 | 7–14 days |
| AI automation | ₹49,999 | scoped per process |
| Mobile app (iOS + Android) | ₹99,999 | 3–5 weeks |
| E-commerce store | ₹99,999 | 3–4 weeks |
| ERP software (single module) | ₹99,999 | 4–8 weeks |
| HRMS and payroll software | ₹99,999 | 4–8 weeks |
| Billing and inventory software | ₹99,999 | 4–8 weeks |
| CRM software | ₹99,999 | 4–8 weeks |
| Custom software / dashboards | ₹1,49,999 | 4–8 weeks |
| UI/UX design only | ₹40,000 | scoped per project |
| Managed hosting and maintenance | ₹3,000 per month | ongoing |

Larger systems: a full multi-module ERP typically lands between ₹3,00,000 and ₹10,00,000. A
CRM with WhatsApp Business API, field-sales tracking and ERP integration typically lands
between ₹1,50,000 and ₹4,00,000. A website with custom features typically lands between
₹1,00,000 and ₹3,00,000.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.verelios.com/services): The eleven services Verelios Labs offers, with starting prices and delivery times.
- [Website Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/website-development): Fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites built with React and Next.js. From ₹49,999, live in 7–14 days.
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps from a single React Native or Flutter codebase, shipped to both stores. From ₹99,999.
- [E-commerce Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/ecommerce-development): Online stores with catalogue, cart, Razorpay and UPI, cash on delivery, delivery tracking and GST invoicing. From ₹99,999.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/custom-software-development): Internal tools, dashboards and platforms built around a client's workflow. From ₹1,49,999.
- [ERP Software Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/erp): Inventory, manufacturing, purchase, sales, accounting and reporting in one system, with Tally and GST integration. From ₹99,999.
- [HRMS and Payroll Software](https://www.verelios.com/services/hrms-payroll-software): Attendance, shifts, payslips and automatic PF, ESI and TDS, including contract and piece-rate workers. From ₹99,999.
- [Billing and Inventory Software](https://www.verelios.com/services/billing-inventory-software): GST billing, live stock across godowns, e-way bills and Tally sync. Keeps billing when the internet drops. From ₹99,999.
- [CRM Software Development](https://www.verelios.com/services/crm-software-development): Leads, pipeline, quotations, WhatsApp Business API, call logging and field sales. A one-time build, not per user per month. From ₹99,999.
- [AI Automation](https://www.verelios.com/services/ai-automation): AI agents, chatbots and workflow automation that remove repetitive work. From ₹49,999.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.verelios.com/services/ui-ux-design): Research, wireframing, prototyping and conversion-focused design systems. From ₹40,000.
- [Web Hosting and Maintenance](https://www.verelios.com/services/web-hosting): Managed hosting with 99.9% uptime, backups, SSL, security patches and performance monitoring. From ₹3,000 per month.

## Common questions

- **How much does a website cost in India?** A 5-page business website from Verelios Labs starts at ₹49,999 and goes live in 7–14 days. Websites with custom features, e-commerce or a CMS typically land between ₹1,00,000 and ₹3,00,000. The quote is fixed before work begins.
- **How much does a mobile app cost?** An iOS and Android app from a single codebase starts at ₹99,999 and ships to both stores in 3–5 weeks. Apps with payments, live tracking or deep backend integration typically range from ₹2,00,000 to ₹10,00,000.
- **How much does ERP software cost in India?** A single-module ERP starts at ₹99,999. A full system covering inventory, manufacturing, accounting, HR and payroll typically lands between ₹3,00,000 and ₹10,00,000.
- **How much does HRMS and payroll software cost?** A focused HRMS covering attendance, leave and payslips starts at ₹99,999. It is a one-time build, not a per-employee monthly fee, so the cost does not rise as the client hires.
- **How much does CRM software cost?** A focused CRM covering leads, pipeline, follow-ups and quotations starts at ₹99,999. Adding WhatsApp Business API, call logging, field-sales tracking and ERP integration typically takes it to ₹1,50,000–₹4,00,000. One-time build, not per user per month.
- **How long does a project take?** Most projects launch in under 3 weeks. Business websites take 7–14 days, mobile apps 3–5 weeks, ERP and custom software 4–8 weeks.
- **Can I see something before paying?** Yes. Verelios Labs delivers a free mockup or prototype within 48 hours, before any payment or commitment.
- **How does payment work?** Milestone-based: 30% to start, 30% at mid-delivery, 40% at launch, against a fixed quote agreed up front. There is no hourly billing and the number is not revised mid-project.
- **Who owns the code?** The client does. It sits on the client's own hosting and domain accounts, with full commit history handed over. There is no vendor lock-in.
- **Do you build for both iOS and Android?** Yes, from a single React Native or Flutter codebase, so both apps ship together rather than being paid for twice.
- **Does your software work with Tally and GST?** Yes. ERP, billing and inventory systems integrate with Tally and the GST portal, so the client's accountant's workflow does not change.
- **Can we meet in person?** Yes. The office is at 126/58 G Block, Govind Nagar, Kanpur, open 24 hours every day. The team also visits client premises anywhere in Kanpur, including Kakadeo, Swaroop Nagar, Panki, Dada Nagar, Barra and Jajmau.
- **Do you work outside Kanpur?** Yes. Kanpur and Uttar Pradesh are served in person; the rest of India is served remotely, with the same free 48-hour mockup and milestone payments.
- **Do you help with SEO?** Every website ships with on-page SEO by default — semantic HTML, titles and meta descriptions, structured data, an XML sitemap, fast Core Web Vitals and Google Search Console setup.
- **When is Verelios Labs not the right choice?** When an off-the-shelf product genuinely fits. For a three-person team whose sales process matches a standard pipeline, Zoho CRM or a similar subscription tool is a better and faster answer than a custom build, and Verelios Labs says so rather than selling around it. Custom starts paying off when per-user fees become significant, when the process does not match the template, or when systems must integrate in ways a standard plan will not allow.
